sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission conducted a final review of one outstanding recommendation arising from a police use of force incident in a country town lock-up.
sentences.support: This final review considers the WA Police Force's further response to the outstanding recommendation.

sentences.text: The review considered revised rules requiring force reports when an officer identifies bodily injury or the person subjected to force identifies or claims it, regardless of medical care.
sentences.support: Under the amended policy, a use of force report is required if bodily injury is identified by an officer or identified or claimed by the subject.

sentences.text: The Commission considered the reporting instructions clearer and closed the remaining recommendation.
sentences.support: The changes appear to provide clearer instructions for when a use of force report is required

sentences.text: The Commission said the effect of the changes would depend on their application by officers and committed to continued monitoring.
sentences.support: the true test of the changes implemented, can only be determined through the application of the policy by officers.

findings.quote: The Commission considers this recommendation is complete.

notes: No separate executive summary or equivalent consolidated summary was identified. This final review addresses one of four earlier recommendations.
